label: L-02
title: Neither the on-chain Unprofitable check nor harvest.sh's minEthOut floor prices the claim NFT burned by SYA; default config sends net-loss harvests
description: Profitability floor = gas only (on-chain (g0-gasleft+60k)*tx.gasprice; script gasLimit*maxFee + MIN_PROFIT_WEI default 0). src/CLAUDE.md Purpose defines profitable as '> gas + NFT cost'; the settled design decision and stories 003/005 specify gas only, so the spec contradicts itself.
impact: Caller self-loss of up to about one claim-NFT mint price per harvest (index 1 ~10.78 USD) when the shipped harvest.sh default (MIN_PROFIT_WEI=0) sends harvests whose ETH out covers gas but not the NFT burned. No third party extracts value; protocol unaffected.
attackPath: Not an attack: operator runs harvest.sh with defaults; the floor prices gas only; a harvest netting less than the NFT's value is sent (story-005's own anvil run nets ~-2.2 USD).
assumptions: Caller values the burned NFT at its mint price.
severityRationale: Real but self-inflicted and parameter-controlled loss to the operator using its own tool, with no attacker and no protocol impact. C4 places caller-side economics with a configurable floor in QA/Low. Kept at Low (not QA) because the shipped default systematically sends net-loss transactions and the project's own Purpose definition of 'profitable' (> gas + NFT cost) is violated; the spec contradicts itself, so F-01 goes to spec-conformance for the owner to reconcile.
recommendation: N/A (self-inflicted loss). Mitigation: add an NFT_COST_WEI / MIN_PROFIT_WEI default derived from NFTMinterV2.getPrice(nftIndex) converted to ETH, or document that MIN_PROFIT_WEI must be set to at least the NFT's value. In harvest.sh, read nftMinter.getPrice(NFT_INDEX), convert to ETH (V4 pool slot0 or the simulated USDC/ETH rate) and add it to GAS_FLOOR; default MIN_PROFIT_WEI to that value or refuse to run without it. Document the NFT cost in the README. Owner to reconcile the spec (F-01).

evidence.econFork: Neither profitability gate prices the claim-NFT unit SYA burns. Fork evidence shows this is systematic, not an edge case: at the story-004/005 reference state the flagship 'profitable' full harvest pays 10.822 USD of ETH while burning NFT index 1 whose mint price is 10.783 USDC (+0.04 USD before gas, about -0.45 USD after gas at basefee+0.01 gwei; story-005's own validation 'profitable send' netted 0.00365 ETH ~ 8.5 USD against the same 10.78 USD NFT, i.e. ~-2.2 USD). A USDe-only harvest (USDC+DOLA exempt) succeeds on-chain and would be sent by harvest.sh (default MIN_PROFIT_WEI=0) paying 2.65 USD for a 10.78 USD NFT. At today's ~0.03 gwei base fee the gas floor is ~0.1-0.5 USD, so harvest.sh fires once pending yield exceeds ~1-2 USD, while the NFT-adjusted break-even is NFT/discount = 10.78/0.30 ~ 36 USD of pending yield (index 7: ~233 USD).
evidence.code: cast call 0x39Af...E10F getPrice(1) -> 10782880; dispatcher 0x9cd4...19f3b3 primeToken() -> USDC; harvest_anvil.sh case 5 'operator ETH rose by 3649871151856064 wei net of gas'.

faithfulness.specText: src/CLAUDE.md Purpose: "A claim therefore has positive expected value whenever `market value of the yield tokens - discounted USDC payment > gas + NFT cost`."  versus  src/CLAUDE.md settled 'Gas check' bullet, story-003 Acceptance "The gas check reverts `Unprofitable` when `ethOut < (gasUsedSoFar + GAS_OVERHEAD) * tx.gasprice`" and story-005 Overview "Derives a `minEthOut` that guarantees the gas is covered."
faithfulness.specSource: src/CLAUDE.md (Purpose + Design decisions); story-003 doc Acceptance; story-005 doc Story Overview step 4 / Technical Details step 4
faithfulness.deviation: The code faithfully implements stories 003 and 005, and the stories faithfully implement the settled Gas-check decision. Only the CLAUDE.md Purpose invariant ('> gas + NFT cost') fails to hold. The project spec contradicts itself: the purpose names NFT cost, while every lower-level spec (design decision, story-003, story-005, README) names only gas. This is a spec-level gap, not an implementation slip.

crossProjectReferences.note: No SYA entry covers claim-NFT cost being left out of a profitability floor. Related context only: QA-01 (sya12qa1, open), the first claimer captures the whole discount and minRewardTokenSupplied defaults to 0.
